verse: Lord, I will sing about your great love forever. For all time to come, I will tell how faithful you are. I will tell everyone that your love stands firm forever. I will tell them that you are always faithful, even in heaven itself. Lord, the heavens praise you for your wonderful deeds. When your holy angels gather together, they praise you for how faithful you are. Who in the skies above can compare with the Lord? Who among the angels is like the Lord? God is highly respected among his holy angels. He’s more wonderful than all those who are around him. Lord God who rules over all, who is like you? Lord, you are mighty. You are faithful in everything you do. You rule over the stormy sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them down.
